title: Silverback
summary: Silverback lets you create and deploy your own Python bots that respond to on-chain events.
description: Silverback is a library that leverages the Ape development framework to enable the development of automated bots that monitor and respond to live chain data. It is ideal for use cases involving continuous monitoring of on-chain events, such as newly confirmed blocks or contract event logs.
